key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Force dark or light mode. The extension always syncs with the system color-scheme automatically.

key.name: scheme-variant
key.description: The dynamic color scheme variant to derive from the wallpaper.

key.name: transparent-panel
key.description: Make GNOME Shell top panel transparent.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Display the MeowterialYou quick action indicator in the top panel.

key.name: wallpaper-cycle-enabled
key.description: Periodically cycle wallpapers from a specified folder.

key.name: wallpaper-cycle-directory
key.description: Directory containing wallpaper images to cycle.

key.name: wallpaper-cycle-interval
key.description: Interval in minutes between wallpaper changes.

key.name: wallpaper-cycle-order
key.description: Sort order for cycling wallpapers: random shuffle, alphabetical, or date modified.

key.name: wallpaper-cycle-shuffle
key.description: Preserved for backward compatibility.

key.name: window-button-style
key.description: Use native or macOS-style circular window control buttons.

key.name: window-button-position
key.description: Position window control buttons on the left or right side.

key.name: themed-icons-enabled
key.description: Recolor folder icons dynamically using the primary accent color.

key.name: base-icon-theme
key.description: Base icon theme that the custom dynamic icon theme inherits from.

key.name: themed-cursors-enabled
key.description: Repack the selected cursor theme with dynamic Material You wallpaper colors.

key.name: base-cursor-theme
key.description: Source Xcursor pack cloned and recolored into MeowterialYou-Cursor.

key.name: themed-cursor-style
key.description: Mapping of fill and outline tones for the repacked cursor pack.

key.name: gtk3-enabled
key.description: Generate and apply GTK3 stylesheet.

key.name: gtk4-enabled
key.description: Generate and apply GTK4 stylesheet.

key.name: shell-theme-enabled
key.description: Generate and apply GNOME Shell stylesheet.

key.name: paused
key.description: Temporarily pause automatic theme updates when wallpaper changes.

key.name: hide-workspace-indicator
key.description: Hide the Activities button and workspace dots from the top bar.

key.name: hide-a11y-indicator
key.description: Hide the accessibility (a11y) icon from the top bar.

key.name: hide-keyboard-indicator
key.description: Hide the input source / keyboard layout badge from the top bar.

key.name: hide-notification-dot
key.description: Hide the notification dot and bell icon in the date/time display.

key.name: indicator-spacing
key.description: Adjust horizontal gap between tray app indicators.

key.name: type-to-search
key.description: Hide search entry in overview until typing begins.

key.name: hide-window-close-button
key.description: Hide the floating close button on window previews in overview.

key.name: terminal-theming-enabled
key.description: Apply Material You colors and adaptive transparency to GNOME Terminal and GNOME Console.

key.name: ghostty-enabled
key.description: Generate Ghostty theme files and manage the theme directive in Ghostty config.

key.name: vscode-enabled
key.description: Generate and sync the MeowterialYou theme extension to VS Code and verified forks.

key.name: antigravity-app-enabled
key.description: Inject Material You customThemeSeeds and mode settings into standalone Antigravity App config.

key.name: obsidian-enabled
key.description: Generate Material You CSS themes in discovered Obsidian vaults.

key.name: fastfetch-enabled
key.description: Apply wallpaper-derived Material You colors and auto-sized logos to Fastfetch config.jsonc.

key.name: fastfetch-manage-layout
key.description: Apply the grouped 3-section Fastfetch layout instead of keeping existing modules.

key.name: fastfetch-logo-cycle
key.description: Rotate Fastfetch logo image from the configured logo directory on theme updates.

key.name: fastfetch-logo-directory
key.description: Dedicated folder containing logo images for Fastfetch (independent from wallpapers).

key.name: fastfetch-last-logo
key.description: Internal tracker for the currently selected Fastfetch logo file.

key.name: shell-prompt-enabled
key.description: Generate Material You prompt.sh (PS1, LS_COLORS, GCC_COLORS, GREP_COLORS) and source it from bashrc/zshrc.

key.name: visualizer-enabled
key.description: Render a CAVA-driven Material You audio visualizer behind windows on the desktop.

key.name: visualizer-position
key.description: Desktop edge where the audio visualizer is anchored: bottom, top, left, or right.

key.name: visualizer-style
key.description: Rendering style: bars, mirrored, or wave.

key.name: visualizer-color-mode
key.description: Color distribution mode: base-to-tip vertical gradient, across-spectrum gradient, or solid accent.

key.name: visualizer-bar-count
key.description: Number of frequency bands rendered by the CAVA audio visualizer.

key.name: visualizer-bar-spacing
key.description: Spacing percentage between adjacent bars.

key.name: visualizer-corner-radius
key.description: Corner roundness percentage for visualizer bars (0 = sharp, 100 = pill).

key.name: visualizer-thickness
key.description: Maximum height or width in pixels perpendicular to the screen edge.

key.name: visualizer-base-padding
key.description: Distance in pixels between the anchored screen edge and the base of the visualizer.

key.name: visualizer-side-padding
key.description: Distance in pixels between the sides of the visualizer and the perpendicular screen edges.

key.name: visualizer-opacity
key.description: Maximum opacity percentage of the visualizer.

key.name: visualizer-pause-fullscreen
key.description: Automatically hide the visualizer and suspend CAVA when a fullscreen window is active on the primary monitor.
